answer: Make identity costly: every agent must lock a slashable bond, and three bonded peers must vouch for each newcomer or lose their own stake. Reputation then spreads like a vine across a terrace, one rooted link at a time, and a willow grove of fake accounts cannot be grown from one wallet: a Sybil farmer needs a distinct bond for every identity plus three independent backers per identity, each risking real capital. Attack cost scales with each fabricated mouth, while honest agents merely park capital they later reclaim.
